name: Jace HQ
tagline: Service operations leader who also builds the systems.
description: Zero-build personal portfolio focused on Toyota service operations, customer-pay revenue, workflow improvement, and applied AI. Separates current revenue from earlier benchmarks to avoid misleading math, with semantic HTML, reduced-motion support, JSON-LD, and direct contact actions.

name: Agent Control Stack
tagline: A policy-gated control plane for agent work.
description: Local-first TypeScript control plane that turns untrusted agent requests into durable work items, applies policy, binds approvals to exact actions, gives workers leases, stores immutable results, and records tamper-evident audit evidence. Includes MCP transport.

name: AgentHarness
tagline: Isolated, killable execution with durable authority.
description: A .NET agent harness with one routing choke point, isolated killable execution, and a durable state store for turns, runs, and attempts. Built as a runtime and host only. Policy stays with an external authority such as ACS.

name: Prompt Foundry
description: Responsive Next.js prompt library with full-text search, 14 inferred categories, sorting, pagination, a detail modal that detects ${...} variables, one-click copy, favorites, light and dark themes, and optional publishing to the shared library through GitHub.

name: DealPilot
tagline: No claim without evidence. No evidence without provenance.
description: Evidence-first AI underwriting and decision-intelligence platform. It gathers evidence, verifies claims, quantifies risk, estimates value, surfaces uncertainty, and produces auditable evidence memos. Unknowns are labeled UNKNOWN instead of guessed.

name: Relay
tagline: Room chat built to teach FastAPI WebSockets.
description: Real-time room chat for learning FastAPI WebSockets, async Python, and event-driven design. Browsers join rooms and exchange messages instantly with no polling. Messages persist in SQLite, and presence, typing, and reconnect are first-class events on a documented JSON protocol.

name: Terminal Canvas
tagline: Market data that never fakes a number.
description: Interactive market dashboard built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, backed by a protected Express market-data service. It has two explicit modes, simulated or authenticated provider data. Failed datasets are reported as degraded and are never backfilled with random values.

name: Jackson County Property Intelligence
tagline: Kansas City real-estate intelligence on PostGIS.
description: Jackson County assessor dashboard over Postgres and PostGIS with dashboard, property, and map APIs, an MCP endpoint, and RentCast as a secondary provider. The public Pages build is a static shell only, and owner PII stays behind authentication.

name: Deal Hunter
tagline: True market value scoring for resellers.
description: Docker-first deal discovery and valuation platform. The TMV Engine ingests listings, stores sold-market samples, calculates a true market value, scores deals for profit and risk, and ranks opportunities in a React SPA.

name: Toyota Showroom
tagline: The 4Runner you are driving was built here.
description: Three.js WebGPU vehicle builder with a WebGL2 fallback. It uses real GLB assets, including the optimized 2024 4Runner TRD Pro model driving this world (cut from 28 MiB to about 1.2 MiB). Also includes paint and option configuration, persistence, and a Cloudflare D1 schema.

name: Lexus Showroom
tagline: ES, NX, RX, and LX in light and dark.
description: React and TypeScript single-page showroom for the Lexus ES, NX, RX, and LX lineup, built with Vite and Tailwind CSS. Includes model routes, light and dark themes, and scripted README screenshot capture.

name: Jayota
tagline: A dealer site with inventory, offers, and leads.
description: Dealer showroom built with Vite, React, and TanStack. PGlite handles local and preview data, typed adapters cover inventory, offers, and leads, and every external provider has a documented fail-closed fallback.

name: ShiftForge
tagline: Build, style, and render custom car concepts.
description: Real-time Three.js car configurator with paint, finish, wheel, diameter, stance, aero, and scene controls. Includes local and cloud build history, real image-to-image AI concept rendering, an SEO comparison hub, and structured data.

name: Diagnostic Decision Lab
tagline: Differential diagnosis with a causal simulator.
description: Automotive differential-diagnosis engine. Take a complaint, rank hypotheses, log evidence, and pick the next-best test. The simulator runs six causal Toyota and Lexus cases on the same engine, and the hidden fault never seeds the differential. Scan, DVOM, and scope tools are included.

name: Toyota Dashboard
tagline: Repair orders, blockers, and follow-ups in one control room.
description: Service-lane operations dashboard and MCP server for repair orders, blockers, follow-ups, recommendations, and advisor workflows. Uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, user-scoped ownership checks, optimistic concurrency, and narrow write tools.

name: Toyota Maintenance
description: Service-advisor lookup tool. Pick a vehicle configuration and odometer reading to get factory items due now, the next milestone, an OEM-style interval grid, an advisor talk track, and a print-ready customer sheet. Every result carries its source provenance.

name: Maintenance Matchmaker
tagline: Year, model, mileage: here is what is due.
description: Toyota service recommendation tool for dealership advisors. Enter a year, model, and mileage to get the maintenance due at the next interval, priced and grouped by priority. Includes a customer-facing presentation mode and an oil-package break-even calculator.
